args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The test suite expects banker's rounding (2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66),
but round_money quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build
to fail. Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN as documented in the docstring.

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `round_money` using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: `round_money` now quantizes with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`, matching the existing docstring and FIN-212.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `test_half_even` (2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).
